title: Create a single partition on a disk
summary: Reformat a disk and create one partition that fills the entire available space. You can specify the filesystem type and the name of the new partition.

steps.explain: Reformat the disk and create a single partition using the specified filesystem and name, occupying all free space.

placeholders.name: DISK_DEVICE
placeholders.description: The identifier of the disk to partition (e.g., /dev/disk2).

placeholders.name: PARTITION_SCHEME
placeholders.description: The partition scheme: APM, MBR, or GPT.

placeholders.name: FILESYSTEM
placeholders.description: The filesystem type for the partition (e.g., APFS, HFS+, FAT32).

placeholders.name: PARTITION_NAME
placeholders.description: The name to assign to the new partition.

warnings: This command will erase all existing data on the disk.
Verify the disk identifier carefully before running.

rollback.explain: Data erased by this command cannot be recovered using standard tools. Restore from a backup if available.
